briefdescription.para: This function is a stub for designs that do not enable the PMC and DDRMC I2C handshake.

detaileddescription.para: The handshake is compiled only when PLM_I2C_MB_HANDSHAKE is set and the selected I2C controller is present. DDRMC5_I2C_MASTER selects that controller. When it is not set, PMC I2C is used if that instance is present. Every other design returns success.

parameterdescription.para: is pointer to the command structure.

briefdescription.para: This is the file which contains PMC and DDRMC5 handshake process function.
